narrative.overview:
Midnight aerospace materials frame a substantial working plan beside one persistent local conversation. The interface is dense enough for real planning, with clear type, quiet working rows, restrained metadata and cyan actions. IBM Plex Sans carries the work; Oxanium identifies MYMIND without taking over the interface.

This documents the implemented approved D — Complete workflow, not a new visual direction. Calendar, Tasks, editors, Categories and Settings keep the same right-hand conversation available. Assistant enlarges that conversation while retaining a useful visible plan. The pinned [approved Figma workflow](https://www.figma.com/design/SPe2aVUSaUNqmI5Gmnvv1F/MYMIND-wireframe?node-id=68-2825) supplies the visual authority; actual source supplies the measurements and behavior recorded here.
keyCharacteristics: A visible plan and one persistent right-hand conversation.
Midnight tonal surfaces, crisp boundaries and cyan action cues.
Readable working rows with restrained secondary metadata.
Deliberate voice review, truthful progress and recoverable work.

rules.name: The Material Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use `boundary` on interactive fields and outlined containers; use `line` for internal rows and date grids. Preserve the tonal difference between the working surface, navigation surface and raised controls.

rules.name: The Identity Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep Oxanium on MYMIND identity. Use IBM Plex Sans for headings, planner content, fields, conversation and controls.

rules.name: The Persistent Plan Rule
rules.body: Keep the working plan beside the same conversation, including editors and compact windows. Pin composer and editor actions while their content scrolls.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering for persistent working surfaces. Reserve the observed shadows for their transient popup, dialog and toast roles.

rules.name: The Deliberate Voice Rule
rules.body: Preserve Record → same-button Stop → final transcription with live text retained → editable composer → explicit Send. Recording continues through pauses and tab changes. Keep cancellation, saved-dictation recovery, transcript versions, optional voice sessions, spoken replies and Stop response reachable; do not send merely because recording stops.

dos: Do keep a substantial visible plan beside one persistent conversation.
Do use the actual source tokens, local fonts, approved SVG navigation and Thinking Orbs runtime.
Do preserve pinned composer and editor actions at 900×600.
Do keep weekday/date pairs readable through horizontal Calendar scrolling.
Do show real progress, saved results, retry, recovery and applicable Undo actions.
Do preserve the deliberate voice sequence and shared Date behavior.
donts: Don't replace working rows with a second dashboard of decorative cards.
Don't apply Oxanium to content or replace the approved midnight aerospace world.
Don't invent progress, send voice text automatically or discard retained transcripts.
Don't imply that setting Date alone creates Calendar placement.
Don't animate reduced-motion orb states or compress overview dates to fit the pane.
